messages:
Aisha (CEO): Quick live Q — big picture: how do we articulate our moat vs hyperscalers who now offer managed model endpoints?
Priya (CTO): Tech angle: we own inference runtime optimizations + rollout primitives that you can't get from generic endpoints. Focus on economics + deterministic latency.
Miguel (Head of Sales): Sales needs a 1-liner beyond tech. Customers often ask: 'Why not just use cloud provider X?'
Noor (Product): Try: 'We make your LLM features predictable, cheap, and portable across environments.' Short and action-oriented.
Sam (Eng): On portability — what's our plan for enterprise customers that demand air-gapped/offline? Any timeline for Private on-prem GA?
Aisha (CEO): Private GA H2 — roadmap includes on-prem installer + KMS integrations. Prioritize a small set of regulated vertical customers for early feedback.
Cassie (Ops): For Dedicated customers, are we committing to specific latency SLOs per tier? That affects infra ops and runbooks.
Priya (CTO): Yes — offering-level SLOs (p95 inference latency) and a documented escalation playbook. We'll share draft SLAs with SRE next week.
Miguel (Head of Sales): Competitive intel: some vendors tout huge model catalogs. Do we compete on breadth or on curated, verified models?
Noor (Product): Curated wins. Our message: verified performance + rollout safety. Breadth without vetting = risk for customers.
Sam (Eng): Any change to fallback policies? I get asked if we should auto-fallback to quantized variants during spikes.
Aisha (CEO): Allow automatic fallback but make visibility explicit — console flags + request headers. Customers should opt-in for silent fallbacks.
Miguel (Head of Sales): Pricing/packaging question: will we keep a single usage model or split Hosted vs Dedicated pricing more clearly?
Noor (Product): Expect clearer separation — Hosted metered pricing, Dedicated with commit tiers + overage rules, Private via license + support. Draft coming.
Priya (CTO): Also signal to engineering: prioritize kernel/quantization work this quarter — biggest unit-cost impact.
Cassie (Ops): Ops ask: can we get a short runbook for AEs so they can map customer signals (latency, compliance, cost sensitivity) to offering?
Miguel (Head of Sales): Yes please. A cheat-sheet would help close faster.
Slides-bot: Recording + slides uploaded: https://redwood.slides/all-hands/apr-2026 (00:58).
Aisha (CEO): Thanks all — followups: @Noor will publish the AE cheat-sheet draft; @Priya will share SLA/ops doc; @Miguel please add any field examples. Ping me for any one-on-one clarifications. :raised_hands:
